more.text: Counterfeit; false; not genuine; as fictitious fame.

example.quote: By means of a suit, on a real or fictitious claim, the citizens of the most distant states may be brought to the supreme federal court.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 20, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
